title: Self-supervised biomedical signal representation learning from intrapartum cardiotocography for neonatal risk enrichment
description: R1 revision code, manuscript source files, Frontiers official LaTeX submission package, figure source data, supplementary tables, standalone supplementary-table PDFs and reproducibility files for an open-data biomedical signal representation-learning study of self-supervised cardiotocography trajectories, calibrated neonatal risk enrichment and domain-shift assessment. This version uses the fixed-seed locked replay values adopted in revision and supersedes the originally submitted unseeded AUPRC values.
